label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), late in episode / low value
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition (99.8% of mass; never at S2, only 0.2% at rare a2->S1). Within those steps it is strongly gated by episode progress: no activations before ep_trial ~45, rate rising steeply through trials 60-99, and equivalently the model value head is low (value < 7.13 holds 86% of mass; none above 8.1). D2 & a1 & S1 alone gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.10; adding ep_trial >= 70 gives precision 0.32 / mass recall 0.95; the recorded value < 7.13 version (observed, the agent own value estimate) is best by F1 (dev P 0.40, R 0.81, F1 0.54, mass 0.86). Magnitude ramps up over consecutive a1->S1 common trials within a window and is highest when good = S1 and the previous trial was rewarded; it is weaker or absent after a2 or rare trials. Precision stays incomplete: many late a1->S1 D2 steps are silent, with no clean further condition found (prev-trial streak conditions trade recall for little precision). No future variables used.
